environment.description: Same application deployed in namespace 'api-services' on EKS. A Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy named 'restrict-metadata-egress' is applied to pods with label app=graphql-api. The policy spec has an egress rule with a CIDR block denying 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80. Additionally, a second NetworkPolicy 'default-deny-egress' sets policyTypes: [Egress] with no egress rules for the namespace, then a third policy 'allow-required-egress' permits egress only to the PostgreSQL service CIDR (10.100.0.0/16 port 5432) and kube-dns (UDP 53). The pod's service account has an IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) annotation but the associated IAM role has no permissions (empty policy). Worker nodes use IMDSv2 with hop limit 1, meaning container-level metadata requests receive no response due to extra network hop.
